source.author: verg
source.text: Is genus indocile ac dispersum montibus altis composuit legesque dedit Latiumque vocari maluit, his quoniam latuisset tutis in oris.
source.text_original: Is genus indocile ac dispersum montibus altis / composuit legesque dedit Latiumque vocari / maluit, his quoniam latuisset tutis in oris.
source.text_english: He gathered that untaught, scattered race from the high mountains, gave them laws, and preferred that it be called Latium, since under his protection it had lain hidden on those safe shores.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: nam cum agresti quodam more in Italia uiueretur, is genus indocile ac dispersum montibus altis composuit legesque dedit Latiumque uocari maluit, his quoniam latuisset tutus in oris.
reuse.text_original: nam cum agresti quodam more in Italia uiueretur, is genus indocile ac dispersum montibus altis composuit legesque dedit Latiumque uocari maluit, his quoniam latuisset tutus in oris.
reuse.text_english: For when people were living in Italy in a kind of rustic way, he brought together that untutored and scattered race, dwelling in the high mountains, and gave them laws, and preferred that it be called Latium, because he had lain hidden and safe on those shores.
